content.scenario: During an investigation into unfair trade practices, the authorities seize certain documents from a company. The company wants to know when they can expect the documents to be returned.
content.outcome: The seized documents shall be returned to the company within a period of twenty days of the date of seizure, after copies thereof or extracts therefrom certified by the company have been taken.

user_queries: When will the seized documents be returned?
What is the procedure for returning seized documents?
